verdict.rationale: Orrick's own pages mention exit-stage work for venture-backed companies: the UK venture team advises 'through to exit', the France page cites M&A and IPOs for scaleups, and the Technology Transactions page covers sell-side M&A for emerging tech clients. These are passing mentions on location and practice pages rather than dedicated documentation of M&A and IPO track records. Missing for 10: a dedicated M&A or IPO/capital-markets practice page for venture-backed companies, concrete exit deal counts or examples, IPO evidence beyond the France page, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Our venture capital team advises companies and investors at all stages of growth from incubation through to exit
advising early-stage and emerging fintech and biotech companies, future unicorns and scaleups ... on seed to growth capital financings, cross border M&A and IPOs
we advise more than 3,000 emerging technology company clients on commercial agreements, technology transactions, sell-side M&A and financings
We are regularly ranked in the top 10 for global M&A advising multinationals and German corporates ... and increasingly startups
